result.cause:
canNoteUnderfunded = escrow.deployed and MO::canNoteUnderfunded, which needs phase == Frozen, fresh(observation) and not(covered). fresh means observedAt (= s.headTime) <= m.now and m.now - headTime <= 1800. Uncovered is easy: free starts at 0 and the payable total is 10. A reachable path exists, and a scripted quint test passes: deploy, openMonth(202611), observeEligibility, observeRevision, observeClock(1796083300), propose, observeClock(1796342400), autoFreeze, observeHead(1796342400), noteUnderfunded. The sample sets make the freshness side almost unreachable.

1. headTime is monotonic (canObserveHead: time > headTime). timeValues includes 1796342600 and 1796343100, but nowValues goes no higher than 1796342500. Observing either of those heads leaves observedAt > now permanently, so the guard can never hold again. observeHead (weight 6) is enabled from the very first step, before openMonth and deploy. Half its samples are fatal, and it keeps firing for the whole trace.
2. The only usable head is 1796342400, and it must be observed before any chain event moves the escrow clock past it. Deposits use ev times up to 1796343100, and canObserveHead requires time >= escrow.clock.
3. That single head must survive the full chain: eligibility, revision, clock 1796083300, propose, clock at or after the cutoff, freeze. Only then can noteUnderfunded (default weight 1) win against the fatal observeHead and against deposits that make createObligations win.

The surviving fraction of traces is tiny. Under the current load Quint runs at about 1 to 5 traces per second, so the 60-minute cap allows only a few thousand traces. That is far below the nominal 200000/100000/40000. 6364cda9a changed only reserve release in escrow and does not touch this path, so the guard is still dead at 6364cda9a.

Evidence: the baseline first Frozen trace observed head 1796343100 at step 1, after which freshness was impossible. The baseline invariant notNoted (step, depth 40, 3000 samples) found no violation. Even Frozen together with head 1796342400 took about 2400 s, roughly 2400 traces. The baseline probe run of never_allows_canNoteUnderfunded (depth 40, 400 samples) reported "No violation". After adding one later coordinator clock, every sampled head can become fresh again: now 1796343100 minus head 1796342600 or 1796343100 is within 1800 s. The same probe then found a witness in 3 of 3 seeds within 13 to 43 s, and notNoted was violated on the first traces, ending with headTime=1796343100, now=1796343100, free=[0], underfundedNotice=true.

result.cause:
The guard is not too strict and is satisfiable. A directed probe in ms-scratch-obsexist/directed.qnt runs deploy, openMonth(202611), observeEligibility(eligible), observeRevision(revisionSample), observeClock(1796083300), propose(snapshotSample, [], revisionSample), observeClock(1796342400), autoFreeze, observeHead(1796342400), deposit 4 at t1, deposit 8 at t2, createObligations([0], []), commitManualAward(monthKey(1), 1, [2], t3, "owner") and then canObserveExistingAward(s, 1). That is 14 events, and every guard on the path, the target included, evaluates true. Each check was `quint run directed.qnt --invariant rX --max-steps 0` and returned "No violation".

The harness misses it for two reasons that multiply.

(1) The shared prefix is rare: the month almost never reaches Funded with a fresh head. createObligations needs headTime <= now <= headTime+1800. nowValues tops out at 1796342500. All chain events have time >= 1796342400. timeValues holds 1796342600 and 1796343100, and canObserveHead requires time >= escrow.clock. So the only usable head is 1796342400, observed while at most the block-1 event has happened. After that, any further observeHead (weight 6) or a second deposit makes the head permanently stale. The guard probe also uses step "probe", which spends about half its steps on eval_ actions, so it covers only about 10, 20 or 50 real events at depths 20, 40 or 100. Measured on the current gen, `--step probe`:
- Frozen was reached quickly.
- The noFreshFrozen milestone needed about 1300 traces at depth 40.
- noFunded found no state in 3000 traces at depth 20 or in 2000 traces at depth 40.
- At depth 100, about 32 minutes under load 300-700 also found no state before I stopped it.

(2) Even once Funded is reached, the event that enables this guard is about 20x rarer than its competitors. Only a hand award with exactly (source monthKey(1), actor 1, gross [2]) enables it. Arguments are sampled independently from sourceValues (2), actorValues (3) and grossValues (2), so only 1/12 of commitManualAward attempts match. weight_commitManualAward is 2 out of a step weight of 122. Two weight-12 events close the window for actor 1 sooner: commitObligation (actor 1 is a third of its picks) and admitRoot (rootSample). Before obligations exist, createObligations (weight 12) ends the earlier window. So per-step odds are about 0.17 against about 10. A conflicting award matches 5/12 of attempts, which is why sometimesConflicted is reached and this guard is not.

Conditioned check: init at the directed Frozen, fresh-head, 12-free state; depth 20 probe; quint run never_allows_canObserveExistingAward; two seeds per variant:
- Current samples: hit after roughly 40-75 traces.
- noConflict on the same start: about 8 traces.
- weight_commitManualAward 6: about 1-2 traces.
- grossValues={[2]} alone: no clear gain (45-48 s, against 22-37 s for the current samples).

End-to-end check: probe step, depth 40, 3000 samples, seeds 41 and 42.
- nowValues fix alone (sibling fix: adds 1796343100): the Funded milestone was hit in about 45 traces, but never_allows_canObserveExistingAward found nothing for either seed (2207 s and 2191 s, 3000 traces each).
- nowValues fix plus weight_commitManualAward 6: found for both seeds (1891 s and 2214 s).

The witness trace for seed 42 ran deploy, deposit, commitManualAward, openMonth, …, propose, observeClock, finalize, createObligations, observeExistingAward. It took the hand-award-before-obligations path. In that path the held source blocks commitObligation(1) and admitRoot until the award is observed, so the guard then stays enabled until it fires.

result.target: monthlySettlement guards canAdmitRoot / canMaterialize (events admitRoot, materialize) and canReleaseReserve (releaseReserve), at 6364cda9a
result.cause:
The guards are not wrong. Each one can be satisfied: a direct, deterministic application of the spec functions returns true for canAdmitRoot, canMaterialize and canPropose/canAutoFreeze/canCreateObligations on the obvious path (deploy cap 10 on; open 202611; observe eligible + revisionSample; clock 1796083300; propose snapshotSample; clock 1796342400; autoFreeze; head 1796342400; deposit 8 at block 1 and 4 at block 2; createObligations with no bans; admitRoot(rootSample) at block 3; materialize(leafBase) at block 4). The harness makes that path unreachable or extremely rare. Commit 6364cda9a did not fix releaseReserve here.

(1) releaseReserve is structurally dead. E::canReleaseReserve requires e.implementation == ReleaseCapable. E::initial is PreRelease, E::deploy does not change it, and only E::upgradeToRelease sets it. monthlySettlement wraps every other escrow event but not upgradeToRelease, so no reachable state ever passes. In the direct probe, canReleaseReserve on the admitted state is false and becomes true after E::upgradeToRelease. No sample change can fix this.

(2) The head can never be fresh again. fresh() needs headTime <= month.now <= headTime + 1800. nowValues tops out at 1796342500, but timeValues include 1796342600 and 1796343100, and headTime only grows. observeHead has weight 6, so it usually jumps past 1796342500 and createObligations is then dead forever. In a quint trace, the month was frozen with headTime 1796343100. Baseline probes: a funded month took 2095 s (about 6000 traces), and a funded month with 3 obligations, or any admitted root, was not found in 3000 s at depth 20.

(3) Chain events run out. The 8 evValues blocks are each picked uniformly among the later ones, so each escrow event uses about half of the remaining blocks. Deposits, which can repeat from deploy on, usually reach block 8 first. With only fix (2) in place, quint reached Funded with 3 obligations, but escrow.at was already at block 8 after two deposits. admitRoot then has no later event to use, and neither does materialize.

(4) Smaller losses. Only one of the five nowValues falls inside the proposal window, and the clock never goes back. Half of the bansValues draws ban actor 2, which gives obligations totalling 4, and no authorization matches that. commitObligation (weight 12) competes with admitRoot (12): it shifts sourceSequence or leaves a remainder that no root matches. releaseReserve (weight 1) has to beat materialize (12).

(5) The guard probe takes about half of its steps with eval_* actions, and quint runs at about 3 traces/s here. So the 60-minute cap allows only about 10^4 traces, far fewer than the nominal budgets. A Monte Carlo model of the harness (approximate, scratch mc.mjs) estimated about 0 for every target at the baseline. With the proposed edit, it estimated, at depth 100: admitRoot 7.4e-2, materialize 2.1e-2, releaseReserve 1.0e-2. Removing any one part of the edit cost a factor of 3 to 5.

Confirmation in Quint: I applied the edit to a scratch copy of the repo (ms-scratch-admit/repo). `pnpm -s gen` ran without errors and emitted upgradeToRelease. Its generated step has the same action counts as the hand-edited harness I used for the probes (the counts printed STEP-SAME). With `quint run --step probe --max-samples 20000 --seed 5`:
- never_allows_canAdmitRoot was violated at depth 40 after 124 s and at depth 100 after 425 s.
- never_allows_canMaterialize was violated at depth 40 after 129 s and at depth 100 after 416 s.
- never_allows_canReleaseReserve was violated at depth 40 after 1552 s. That is under the 60-minute cap but needs about half of it. The depth 100 run was stopped unfinished.
Each trace ends with last == the target event.

I stopped the scoped driver early, so the full simulation stage (inv, the sometimes goals including the one at line 213, and the "refuses" probes) has not been re-run on the edit.

Edit spec/settlement/monthlySettlement.md. Rules, laws, stories, step rules and sometimes goals are unchanged, and no guard gets weaker.

A. Genuine composition gap: compose the escrow's finalized release-capable upgrade, as every other escrow event already is. In the "The vault keeps its other operations while the month is reserved" block, add before canReleaseReserve:
```
pure def canUpgradeToRelease(s: MonthlySettlement, ev: E::ChainEvent): bool = E::canUpgradeToRelease(s.escrow, ev)
pure def upgradeToRelease(s: MonthlySettlement, ev: E::ChainEvent): MonthlySettlement =
  { ...s, escrow: E::upgradeToRelease(s.escrow, ev) }
```
In the prose before it, add: "A vault deployed before the reviewed release-capable implementation gains reserve release only through its finalized upgrade event, which this composition passes through from the [escrow](./escrow.md)."

B. Samples, in "Simulation samples":
```
pure val nowValues = Set(1796083300, 1796169600, 1796256100, 1796342400, 1796342500, 1796343100)
pure val depositValues = Set({ vault: "vault", network: E::Base, token: "usdc", amount: List(4) },
  { vault: "vault", network: E::Base, token: "usdc", amount: List(8) },
  { vault: "vault", network: E::Base, token: "usdc", amount: List(12) })
pure val evValues = 1.to(64).map(b => { block: b, index: 0, time: 1796342390 + 10 * b, transaction: "t" })
pure val authorizationValues = Set(rootSample, { ...rootSample, root: "q", remainingGross: List(8), leafCount: 2, sourceSequence: 1 },
  { ...rootSample, root: "b", wholeGross: List(4), remainingGross: List(4), leafCount: 2 })
```
Append to proofValues:
```
  .union(Set({ ...leafBase, root: "b", rootTotal: List(4) }))
  .union(Set({ ...leafBase, root: "b", rootTotal: List(4), index: 1, source: monthKey(3), actor: 3, gross: List(2) }))
```
Add to releaseValues:
```
{ period: 202611, expectedRemaining: List(4), releasedGross: List(4), signer: "attester" }
```
The 64 event times stay at or below 1796343030, so the largest head sample, 1796343100, is never below the vault clock.

C. Weights. Change: weight_materialize 12 to 24, weight_admitRoot 12 to 24, weight_commitObligation 12 to 4, weight_deposit 4 to 2, weight_observeClock 4 to 2, weight_commitManualAward 2 to 1, weight_releaseReserve 1 to 12. - The month observed only head times later than its latest clock, so no projection could ever be fresh. 1796343100 is now a clock value.
- One clock value fell inside the proposal window, and the clock never goes back. Two more lie inside it.

- Half the months banned actor 2, and no signed root fit the remaining 4. A root "b" with its two leaves and its release now covers that month.

- The composition had no upgrade event, so the release-capable implementation was never reached and releaseReserve stayed unreachable.

result.target: monthlySettlement.md, rule "An obligation is reserved, paid or conflicted only as the vault's finalized award shows": goals sometimesLeafObligation, sometimesPoolBlocksManual, sometimesUnderfundedThenDeposit (the three that failed; ManualObligation, MonthReserved, Conflicted, ObligationPaid and ManualAwardOutsideMonth were already reached)
result.cause:
All three goals need a Frozen month with a fresh vault observation. Freshness is `headTime <= now` and `now - headTime <= 1800`. PoolBlocksManual and LeafObligation then need createObligations, then admitRoot, and for the leaf goal also materialize. UnderfundedThenDeposit needs noteUnderfunded, then a deposit, then createObligations.

The cause is in the sample sets. No guard is wrong.

1. Freshness can only hold with headTime exactly 1796342400. The month can freeze only at now >= cutoff 1796342400, and nowValues = {1796083300, 1796342400, 1796342500}, so now is 1796342400 or 1796342500. The head samples are timeValues = {1796083300, 1796342400, 1796342600, 1796343100}. Head 1796083300 is days stale. Heads 1796342600 and 1796343100 lie after every reachable now, and the head can never move back.
2. observeHead almost always overshoots. It has weight 6 and stays enabled while headTime < 1796343100 and time >= escrow.clock. At the start it is 6 of about 10 enabled weight, and from any head it picks uniformly among the larger samples. Head 1796342400 can only be followed by 1796342600 or 1796343100, which kills freshness forever. A trace therefore has to stop observeHead exactly at 1796342400 and keep it from firing again through about 8 to 10 other steps (propose, freeze, deposits, createObligations).
3. observeHead(1796342400) also needs escrow.clock <= 1796342400. So at most one deposit, at block t1, can come before it, while the vault needs 8+4 or 8+8 to cover the 10 owed.
4. Secondary limits: only 8 chain blocks are sampled, and two deposits plus admitRoot plus materialize must take increasing blocks. Only about 0.55 of runs leave room for 3 events and about 0.22 for 4, before other chain events take blocks. Also only 1 of 3 now values falls in the proposal window (now < 1796342400).

None of this is a guard problem. A hand-built path in a probe module shows every guard true on the current generated Quint: canDeploy, canObserveRevision, canPropose, canAutoFreeze, canDeposit(8, block 1), canObserveHead(1796342400), canDeposit(4, block 2), canCreateObligations and canAdmitRoot(rootSample, block 3) all printed true. This is a 13-step path that the random walk practically never stays on.

6364cda9a changed only escrow's whole-reserve release. It does not touch the head, now, deposit or block samples, so these goals are still dead on 6364cda9a.

Fix confirmed: copies of the generated module changed only in samples, run under the harness `--step step` at depth 20, reached all three goals:
- With nowValues = {1796083300, 1796256100, 1796342400, 1796342500, 1796343100}, a 12-unit deposit and 16 blocks: PoolBlocksManual in about 965 s (about 2 traces/s), LeafObligation in about 1892 s, UnderfundedThenDeposit in about 828 s. All used seed 11 and 20000 samples. Every witness had headTime = now = 1796343100.
- A variant with only the now and block changes (no 12 deposit) reached UnderfundedThenDeposit in about 1078 s.
